Hybrid threats in Bosnia and Herzegovina: EUDS mission to Sarajevo 

Press Releases 
EUDS 
23-10-2026 - 12:31  
 

Share this page:

On 26 – 28 October 2026, MEPs of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield will travel to Sarajevo on a fact‑finding visit.

A three‑day mission will assess the scope and impact of hybrid threats and foreign interference on Bosnia and Herzegovina’s democratic institutions and its EU accession process. The delegation will examine disinformation, economic leverage, cyberattacks and other vectors of interference, identify gaps in the country’s resilience, and discuss targeted policy recommendations to strengthen the European Democracy Shield ’s preventive and responsive capabilities in the Western Balkans.
